brief.zh: 把整张图往右挪两格，再往下挪两格。
brief.en: Move the whole image two pixels right and two pixels down.

hint.zh: 一个平移元件只挪一格。它的输出可以接到另一个元件的输入。
hint.en: One shift part moves the image by one pixel. Its output can feed another part's input.

after.zh: 元件可以一个接一个地串起来：前一个的输出就是后一个的输入。几个简单的元件串在一起，能做到单个元件做不到的事，这就是电路。
after.en: Parts can be chained one after another: the output of one is the input of the next. A few simple parts in a row can do what no single part can. That is a circuit.

t.zh: 平移元件每次只把图挪一格。可要挪的，常常不止一格。
t.en: The shift part only ever moves the picture by one pixel. But things often need to move further than that.

t.zh: 一个元件的输出，可以接到另一个元件的输入上：前一个算完，后一个接着算。
t.en: The output of one part can be wired into the input of another: when the first is done, the next carries on.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：把整张图往右挪两格、往下挪两格。
t.en: Your task in this level: move the whole picture two pixels right and two pixels down.

caption.zh: 第一组测试：方块和挪过的方块
caption.en: Set 1: a square and the square moved
